facts.conditions: PTC1 sits on board-b's final +12V output (downstream of U6 L7812CD2T +12V LDO), so its nominal continuous applied voltage is +12V. Margin = fact-ptc1-vmax (6 VDC) minus the 12V nominal rail voltage; a negative margin means the part's own maximum voltage rating is exceeded by the rail it protects under normal (non-fault) operation.
facts.locator: CALCULATED from fact-ptc1-vmax and the project's +12V nominal output rail (CLAUDE.md Project Overview and Technical Architecture; board-b PTC1 downstream of U6 L7812CD2T)
